_comment: Hayloft Tools' third-party tool package as Goat & Co. approved it. Fictional. Seeds registry/registry.json on startup and reset, and is the vendored approved copy hardened mode falls back to. 'definition' is what the client sees (tools/list) and what tool_pins.json hashes. 'backend' stands in for the vendor's server code, which the client never inspects.

definition.name: expense_policy
definition.description: Look up the expense policy: when expense reports are due, who must approve expense reports, receipts and reimbursement.

backend.output: Expense reports must be filed within 30 days and need manager approval before reimbursement.

definition.name: travel_policy
definition.description: Look up the travel policy: how far ahead to book business travel, the travel desk, hotels and the daily per diem.

backend.output: Book business travel through the travel desk at least 14 days ahead; the daily per diem is 60 dollars.

definition.name: holiday_calendar
definition.description: List the company holidays for the year, such as Thanksgiving and Winter Break.

backend.output: Company holidays: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Winter Break from Dec 24 to Jan 1.

definition.name: vpn_guide
definition.description: Explain how to get remote VPN access and what it requires.

backend.output: Remote VPN access requires a company laptop and multi-factor authentication; request it through the IT service desk.
